note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent agent after child.go::installChildDataplane and the E3 rename in rfc4301_sad_selector_linux_test.go changed. RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "If an IPsec system receives an inbound packet on an SA and the packet's header fields are not consistent with the selectors for the SA, it MUST discard the packet." Tested: "it MUST discard the packet". Gap: "If an IPsec system receives an inbound packet on an SA". Producer: internal/component/ike/engine/child.go::installChildDataplane. installChildDataplane validates and attaches both directional state scopes via childStateScope before installing either state. TestRFC4301TunnelModeInboundSelectorsAreEnforcedByTheStateSelector (renamed from ...ByTheRequirePolicy) delivers an in-selector packet and discards source, port and protocol misses at the state selector (XfrmInStateMismatch +1, XfrmInNoPols and XfrmInPolBlock unchanged, no delivery); TestRFC4301TransportModeInboundSADEntryDropsPacketsOutsideItsSelectors drops port-6000 and ICMP echo misses (XfrmInStateMismatch +1); TestRFC4301NonErrorICMPOutsideSelectorsIsDiscarded drops a forged Echo Request (XfrmInStateMismatch +1, Icmp InMsgs unchanged) beside a delivered consistent ICMP error. All tagged fixtures remain single-pair, so multi-pair/sibling isolation stays unproven. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
